hypothesis: The M163 guarded actor update should be accepted for PPO only if it preserves or improves actual continuation outcomes on the M162 boundary geometry replay surface, not just the fixed logprob objective.
success_criteria: replay the M162 M156 boundary corpus rows under M156 and M163 on the same relocated obstacle geometries
compare normal-history and wrong-history continuation outcomes, not only fixed-batch objective loss
verify M163 does not regress normal-history success or clearance on the boundary surface
verify M163 preserves or increases wrong-history degradation where M162 labels say wrong history is dangerous
keep actor inputs unchanged and use M162 labels only as replay selection metadata
state whether guarded PPO smoke is admitted
failure_criteria: admit PPO from M163 using only objective-loss improvement
re-mine an easier boundary surface instead of replaying the M162 rows
feed target ids, geometry keys, outcome scores, or hidden dynamics to the actor
ignore the rejected M163 80-step protected-key failure

commands.name: m164_boundary_outcome_replay_gate
commands.command: Build or run a replay gate that evaluates M156 and M163 on the same M162 boundary rows and records continuation outcome deltas.

decision_rule: Admit guarded PPO smoke only if M163 passes actual boundary-outcome replay retention; otherwise keep M163 as an objective/behavior-positive but rollout-unproven candidate.
